3. LIMITATIONS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
- This is a partial symbolic interpreter, not a verifier.
- Unsupported bytecode clears the symbolic stack; some accesses may therefore be missed.
- Unclassified index expressions are reported separately.
- A symbolic match describes data flow, not game semantics.
